versions.content: Relation of CryptoServicePrimitive . algorithmFamily to CryptoServiceKey . algorithmFamily The attribute CryptoServiceKey . algorithmFamily shall be taken to check with the value of CryptoServicePrimi- tive . algorithmFamily in order to make sure that the crypto key fits to the intended usage.
